Micah Stone: Quick heads-up — follow-up for ACME Dedicated isolation postmortem. Need to sort remediation ownership, timelines, and recurrence controls. Proposing 3 owners: VPC peering, on-prem constraints, and isolation monitoring. Sync at 10am PT?
Jordan Li: +1. Can we list clear action items and owners here before the sync? Also need JIRA tracking.
Micah Stone: Sure. Draft actions:
```
1) VPC peering fix - owner: Ben Park - deliverable: fix + validation script - ETA 2 weeks
2) On-prem resource guardrails - owner: Kim Patel - deliverable: config + infra docs - ETA 1 week
3) Isolation bug patch (race in attach flow) - owner: Carla Romero - deliverable: patch + e2e test - ETA 3 days
4) Monitoring & recurring detection rule - owner: Alice Nguyen - deliverable: alert + dashboard - ETA 5 days
5) Runbook + customer comms - owner: Micah Stone - deliverable: runbook + template email - ETA 2 days
```
Ben Park: I can own VPC peering. Found a reproducible case in `peering-controller` logs. Will open INF-1248 and attach logs. ETA two weeks sounds fine. Will PR network validation pipeline.
Kim Patel: I'll take on on-prem guardrails. Need a quick audit of current customer manifests — looping in @Carla to help with tests. ETA 1 week unless we hit hardware gating.
Carla Romero: Taking the isolation bug. I reproduced locally; race is between attach and binding timeout. I'll push a hotfix branch today and wire up an e2e that simulates tight network latency.
Alice Nguyen: I'll build the detection rule and dashboard. Suggest alert threshold: peer detach > 5% in 10m window. Will prototype in staging by EOD.
Micah Stone: Thanks. I'll own runbook and customer comms, and coordinate having support send draft to ACME by Thu.
Jordan Li: I'll create the epic and link tickets. INF-1248 (Ben) + INF-1249 (Carla) + INF-1250 (Kim) + INF-1251 (Alice) under EPIC INF-1200. Adding acceptance criteria.
Ben Park: quick note — VPC peering fix requires a minor CNI rollback on some onprem nodes; will document compatibility matrix.
Carla Romero: adding e2e test steps to repo `infra/testing/isolations` and will tag `qa` for validation.
DeployBot: Scheduled deploy window for hotfix branch to staging: 2026-03-24 01:00 UTC
Micah Stone: Weekly triage cadence proposed: Friday 9am PT to review progress and recurring patterns. Who's in?
Kim Patel: I'll attend. :thumbsup:
Alice Nguyen: In. I'll bring dashboard samples.
Jordan Li: I'll add the calendar invite and link the epic. Let's keep updates in this thread for the first 72 hours.
Micah Stone: Great — thanks everyone. Action owners, please update your ticket with a brief status by EOD today.
